description: Colorful stack of small handmade ceramics held in hand - gradient glazes in green, yellow, teal, red, pink, blue. Text overlay: 'recent ceramics I made'
engagement_signals: High engagement on hashtag page, top result for #handmadeceramics
why_notable: Simple 'collection showcase' format with hand-held display. Very accessible content style that any small ceramics maker can replicate.
relevance_to_brand: Direct competitor format. TableClay could do similar with their kits' output pieces.

description: Green-glazed chip and dip bowls with beautiful reactive glaze breaking to gold at the edges. 6-image carousel showing the pieces from multiple angles.
engagement_signals: Multiple comments praising the glaze work specifically
why_notable: Reactive/breaking glazes continue to generate strong engagement. The gold-on-green break effect is particularly eye-catching. Carousel format allows showing glaze detail from multiple angles.
relevance_to_brand: Glaze chemistry content could be educational for TableClay's audience interested in the craft side.

description: Dopamine decor ceramics - bright, colorful pottery styled as mood-boosting home decor
why_notable: Dopamine decor trend continues strong in ceramics. Framing pottery as mood/wellness rather than just functional ware. Cross-niche appeal.
relevance_to_brand: TableClay could position kits as 'dopamine crafting' - the mood-boosting angle for at-home pottery making.
